For details, please click here . Note 2 : For Liberal Studies (LS) subject taken in 2023 or before, a Level 2 or above will be considered as “Attained” in Citizenship and Social Development. The LS level will not be considered in the calculation of admission scores. Note 3 : The two subjects may include: (i) 2 elective subjects; or (ii) 1 elective subject and Mathematics (Extended Part) Module I or Module II or Other Language subjects (A2 or above in French / German / Spanish; or N3 or above in Japanese; or Grade 3 or above in Korean; or Grade E or above in Urdu). (iii) For Integrated Science or Combined Science subject(s) taken in 2023 or before, a Level 3 or above will be considered as an unspecified elective subject where applicable. cuhkAdmission.introduction: The Mainstay of Science Education The Faculty of Science has a flexible, broad-based admission scheme that places high priority on individual students and their interests. Students can choose from among 11 major programmes in the Faculty of Science: Biochemistry Biology Biology and Chemistry (Double Major Programme) # Cell and Molecular Biology Chemistry Earth and Environmental Sciences Food and Nutritional Sciences Mathematics Molecular Biotechnology Physics Statistics There is no quota for a specific major. Depending on their preparation, students can declare their major at the time of entry or at the end of Year 1 or 2 # . # Students interested in the Biology and Chemistry Double Major Programme should declare their major at the time of entry or at the end of Year 1.
cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: To equip our students with essential skills and insights for their future careers, the Faculty of Science organises various career development activities and recruitment talks. Upon graduation, students are well prepared to work in diverse sectors. The employment statistics of our graduates over the past five years are summarised as follows: Commerce and Industry – 34% Education – 19% Further Studies – 29% Government – 2% Social and Public Organisations – 5% If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW
cuhkAdmission.craftYourPath: In addition to lectures, tutorials and laboratory sessions, students are encouraged to take part in various experiential learning activities, like internships, and research and exchange programmes to enhance their ability to communicate and gain a wider perspective, thus preparing them for upcoming challenges in the fast changing world. Science Technology and Research Stream (STARS) http://www.sci.cuhk.edu.hk/STARS The Science Technology and Research Stream (STARS) is a research-oriented stream, designed for students with strong academic ability and interest in gaining wider exposure and research experience during their undergraduate studies. Under the supervision of our professors, students in STARS can develop their research interests by joining international conferences, seminars and outgoing exchange programmes.

Any yearly fee adjustment for the 2026 cohort will be capped at 3%. The tuition fee for dual-degree undergraduate programmes may vary. A caution fee of HK$450 must be paid upon enrolment. This is refundable upon withdrawal from the University, but is otherwise usually used as a graduation fee.
